title: Select the release date for version 2
summary: Two dates are possible. The plan recommends 1 March, because the security audit ends on 20 February.

blocks.title: The problem
blocks.html: Version 2 needs a release date. The security audit must end before the release [src: ../report.md].

blocks.title: Why it matters
blocks.html:
• The sales team needs the date 4 weeks before the release.
  • [INFERRED] If the audit finds a problem, the team needs about 1 week to fix it.

options.label: 15 February
options.detail_html: The release is before the audit ends. A problem found by the audit goes into version 2.1.

options.label: 1 March
options.detail_html: The audit ends first. The team has 1 week to fix a problem.

recommendation_html: Option b. It is the earliest date after the audit.
